## monday.com Elevate ‘26 Puts AI Agents to Work: Every Attendee Gets to Build an Agent


####


*monday.com’s flagship conference brings together thousands of business leaders and builders to move AI from experimentation to practical application*


*Ryan Reynolds and Lindsey Vonn to keynote, alongside leaders from LinkedIn, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Spotify*


*The Done Awards, monday.com’s first customer awards program, to recognize AI agents, apps, and workflows built by customers*


NEW YORK & TEL AVIV, Israel–(BUSINESS WIRE)–


monday.com Ltd. (NASDAQ: MNDY) today announced the full program for Elevate ‘26, its flagship annual conference, taking place October 28-29, 2026 at the Javits Center in New York City.


As companies race to adopt AI, many are finding they lack the operational foundation and know-how to truly embed it in their workflows. According to Deloitte’s 2026[State of AI in the Enterprise](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.deloitte.com%2Fcontent%2Fdam%2Fassets-shared%2Fdocs%2Fabout%2F2025%2Fstate-of-ai-2026-global.pdf&esheet=54611769&newsitemid=20260929169324&lan=en-US&anchor=State+of+AI+in+the+Enterprise&index=1&md5=e386360fbce3a83ebe6de9ceb056f226) report, only 30% of companies are redesigning processes around AI.


Elevate ‘26 is built to help attendees move from AI experimentation to practical application. Every attendee will have the opportunity to build a working AI agent, with hands-on workshops, expert sessions, masterclasses, and dedicated building experiences designed to help people put agents to work in their own workflows.


Thousands of attendees are expected to join more than 150 speakers across 200+ sessions, 160+ masterclasses and roundtables, six role-based tracks, and 40+ live AI demos. The[full Elev](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmonday.com%2Felevate%2Flocation%2Fflagship%2Fagenda%2F&esheet=54611769&newsitemid=20260929169324&lan=en-US&anchor=full+Elev&index=2&md5=719fa4bde7f86c810c355d1cca416844)[ate ‘26 age](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmonday.com%2Felevate%2Flocation%2Fflagship%2Fagenda%2F&esheet=54611769&newsitemid=20260929169324&lan=en-US&anchor=ate+%26%238216%3B26+age&index=3&md5=c3db011cd7d4649e8d20092f015c56a4)[nda](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmonday.com%2Felevate%2Flocation%2Fflagship%2Fagenda%2F&esheet=54611769&newsitemid=20260929169324&lan=en-US&anchor=nda&index=4&md5=d8fc3ab808b3948162f21c07d091efad) is available online.


“AI is opening up an entirely new way of working, where people and agents can accomplish more together,” said Roy Mann, co-founder and co-CEO of monday.com. “At Elevate, we want people to experience that potential firsthand: to build agents, integrate them into their day-to-day, and leave with new ways to move their work and businesses forward.”


**Hands-on AI at Elevate ‘26**


Guided tutorials will take attendees from curious to capable, regardless of technical background. The hands-on program includes:


- **Certification Day:** A fully AI-focused curriculum in a four-hour hands-on workshop
- **Expert Bar:** 1:1 time with monday.com product experts
- **AI Hive:** 1:1 time with certified monday.com partners to implement AI in an attendee’s own workspace
- **Masterclasses:** Three times as many as in 2025, from beginner to advanced
- **Elevate Labs:** Dedicated building stations where attendees can create a working agent through a guided experience and learn how to apply it to their work


**Elevate ‘26 Speakers**


Elevate ‘26 will bring together more than 150 speakers, including Ryan Reynolds and Lindsey Vonn, alongside business and technology leaders from LinkedIn, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Spotify.


- **Ryan Reynolds** is an entrepreneur, producer, screenwriter, and actor who has built and invested in businesses including Aviation Gin, Mint Mobile, Maximum Effort, and Wrexham AFC. Reynolds is also a co-owner of the BONDS Flying Roos SailGP Team, proudly supported by monday.com as a Global Partner. At Elevate ‘26, Reynolds will discuss what turns bold ideas into businesses people care about and the role creativity plays in building brands that stand out.
- **Lindsey Vonn** is an Olympic gold medalist, four-time World Cup champion, and New York Times bestselling author who returned to competitive skiing after retirement and a knee replacement. At Elevate ‘26, Vonn will share lessons on resilience, performance, and what it takes to come back after a career-defining setback.


They will be joined by Paolo Provinciali, VP Marketing, Growth, Performance & Operations at LinkedIn; Nina Harding, Corporate Vice President at Microsoft; Rafi Nulman, Director of Product Management, AI Transformation for Central Growth at Meta; Ankita Sharda, Head of AI, FDE and Pursuit Lead at Google; Rachel Skaff, SVP Worldwide Sales at FedEx; and Meagan Bang, Global Lead, Partnerships Strategy & Operations at Spotify.


**The Done Awards: monday.com’s first customer awards program**


On October 29, monday.com will announce the winners of The Done Awards live on the Elevate ‘26 Main Stage. The Done Awards is monday.com’s first customer awards program. It recognizes work customers have already built and put into action on monday.com, whether a workflow, an agent, or a vibe app that changed how a team operates. Judging is based on impact, including hours saved, errors reduced, and output scaled.

**About monday.com**


monday.com is the AI workspace where people and agents drive business results together. Around 250,000 customers worldwide use monday.com to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together in one flexible workspace, where AI doesn’t just assist, it executes. From work management and CRM to service and dev, every monday.com product runs on the same AI layer, automating tasks, running workflows, and helping teams deliver exponentially more with less effort.
